interface.name: ext_zwwm_toplevels_v1
interface.description: Enumerates toplevels available to this manager binding. Availability and global visibility are compositor policy rather than part of this wire contract.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All handles created by this manager are closed. No manager done event follows destruction; clients should normally destroy handles first.

event.name: toplevel
event.description: The handle is opaque, is not a wl_surface or client object id, and is valid only until its closed event. Its initial metadata is sent as handle events before the manager done boundary.

event.name: done
event.description: Sent after all initial handles and their metadata, and after each batch of live additions, changes, and closures. Clients must not present a partially received batch.

description.summary: the inventory ended; no more events follow

interface.name: ext_zwwm_toplevel_handle_v1
interface.description: Metadata may be empty when unavailable. A handle cannot be used after closed, and closed is terminal.

request.name: capture
request.description: This one-shot capture renders the selected client surface tree at client-logical size. It excludes compositor decoration, effects, opacity, animation, occlusion, and unrelated scene nodes. The cursor is included only when requested and supported. The returned frame advertises a SHM buffer contract; source loss is a nonfatal failure.

description.summary: decorated logical rectangle in the current output
current output, if it is available to this client
the toplevel is no longer available; terminal
